typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep headings tight (tracking-tight) and labels uppercase and wide.

colors.rules: Avoid pure #000000. Use tinting. Hover states must be lighter/brighter and accessible.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12) for hero sections, Dense (p-4, gap-4) for data matrix.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid for Tools and Matrix, Asymmetric Bento for Hero and Marketing sections.
spacing_and_layout.rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding. Grid items must be direct children.

surface_strategies.nav_header: Crystal Glass: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Flat background #0a0a0a, 1px solid border-white/10, no shadow. Hover: border-primary/50 -translate-y-1 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,255,65,0.1)]
surface_strategies.compatibility_checker: Tracing Beam style: 1px border with glowing primary color (border-primary/50) and subtle blur behind.

components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm, high contrast. Primary: bg-primary text-black font-bold hover:bg-primary_hover hover:text-black. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:border-white hover:text-white
components.forms: Shadcn UI Select and Input, customized with square corners, dark backgrounds (bg-surface), and primary color focus rings (focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary).
components.tables: Dense, grid-borders, text-sm, distinct alternating row colors.
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for a technical/developer feel.

animations.entrance: Fade in and slide up for lists and grids.

hero_image.description: Close up of computer screen with code, hacker terminal vibe
hero_image.placement: Hero section right side or as a background image with heavy bg-black/70 overlay to ensure text contrast

abstract_tech_bg.placement: Background for Compatibility Checker or Testimonials with heavy dark overlay

iphone_mockup.placement: Beside the device support matrix or tutorials to ground the technical data in reality

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, etc) following kebab-case, role-based naming conventions.
Strictly follow the Retro-Futurism/Terminal archetype: dark backgrounds, high contrast neon accents (Terminal Green #00FF41 or Cyan #00E5FF), and technical grid layouts.
Use JetBrains Mono for all headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Build the Compatibility Checker using highly customized Shadcn components (Select, Button) that look like terminal inputs. Do not use generic Vercel-like styles.
Do not use default generic Shadcn card styles. Implement the 'Grid Borders' or 'Tracing Beam' surface strategy for cards to expose the skeleton.
Include an educational disclaimer prominently in the Hero section, stating the site is for educational purposes only.
Never use generic placeholder images or text. Use the provided media URLs.
Implement a sticky nav with Crystal Glass effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60).
For the tools directory, present Palera1n, Dopamine, Unc0ver, Checkra1n, Taurine, etc. as technical 'nodes' or cards in a strict grid.
Ensure hover states explicitly set text and background colors to maintain high contrast (e.g., hover:bg-primary hover:text-black).
Add 'prefers-reduced-motion' media query checks if implementing complex animations.
